scope.first_model: Current caller-owned configured default deepseek-flash at DeepSeek;no arbitrary request API key/base URL/model name.
scope.fixed_scope: One existing ready C3 index_ref and its exact fixed_representations selection,1..32 unique targets,all in the same owned domain. No implicit latest. Reuse current C3 readiness/staleness and provenance checks without changing their meaning.
scope.real_material: Development and acceptance synthetic only. Existing real AICS external-use restriction remains.

policy.default: Absent row is version0,disabled;existing domains are never auto-enabled.
policy.inspect: No model call. Return current policy version,exact scope digest,non-secret model configuration digest,destination origin and fixed limits.
policy.enable: Owner confirms external sending for that exact fixed snapshot and model configuration. Epoch-first transaction,compare expected version and recomputed scope/model digests,then increment version.
policy.disable: Increment version and clear the allowed scope/model. Does not recall text already sent to the provider. Returned/cached results still require current authorization.
policy.model_digest: Canonical provider/instance/model identities,model name,base URL and region,excluding API keys,usage and verification flags. Changed destination/model requires a new inspect/confirmation;routine key rotation at the same destination is not a new destination.

execution: Existing native identity and owner-source/read checks,policy version and exact fixed-scope checks. Ignore client identity claims in metadata.

Use existing C3 lexical search only;question is default retrieval query,optional keyword override;top5 whole authorized evidence units,maximum32768UTF8bytes. No embedding,rerank,remote fetch,query-rewrite model or reindex side branch.
Reread each fixed evidence reference through its owning current service;never copy protected data into an unregistered dataset.
Resolve existing configured provider credential as an opaque complete value via the native model service. No new private-file parser in application code.
Persist a dispatch/idempotency marker before network work;release SQL locks before provider HTTP. One deepseek-flash call,thinking disabled,temperature0.1,max_tokens1024,no retries/failover.
Raw model output must be closed JSON with answer,insufficient_evidence,evidence_ids. Every ID must be in actual supplied context. No silently dropping invalid citations.

Reread cited references after generation and recheck current owner permission,policy and scope/model bindings before emitting any answer. Disable/revocation/stale data discards the buffered result. No token streaming in the first version.
citation_semantics: Server proves membership,fixed version,current permission and exact bytes. General semantic entailment is not mechanically guaranteed;strict subject-focused prompting and gold/adversarial evaluation remain necessary. UI shows the cited fixed source.

idempotency.key_scope: Current user+domain+idempotency key;canonical body digest mismatch is409.
idempotency.provider_cap: At most one provider dispatch for a key. Same-key POST polls or returns a revalidated cached result,never resends the model call.
idempotency.unknown: Ambiguous provider timeout/connection outcome remains unknown;same-key request cannot dispatch again. New-key resubmission requires a deliberate user action.
idempotency.retention: Answer body cache24h;minimal idempotency/audit metadata7days. Expired cached result returns a closed conflict,not an automatic regeneration. No source document deletion.

storage.constraints: Additive Go-owned migration only;named indexes by column set,explicit bound ID predicates,zero enabled policies on migration. No changes to frozen existing schemas or existing account credentials.

wire.closed_errors: No raw provider/config/SQL error or secret in diagnostics.

read_access_epoch: Generation policy version is separate from read-sharing authority;locking follows epoch-first order but changing this owner-only policy does not itself increment the existing shared-read epoch or invalidate unrelated MCP credentials.
old_paths: Existing CheckDatasetModelUse and all old registered-domain embedding/rerank/generation restrictions remain unchanged. Only the new explicitly approved owner-bound service may obtain a narrow generation authorization. No old native Chat API or MCP tool silently gains access.
rollout: Existing API/Web services and8-service runtime;no new container. Scoped Go tests via build.sh,LLD20 build and all affected help modes;Web tests/lint/build and actual solo synthetic browser+HTTP acceptance before local release. Normal commit/push each completed stage.
